notes.title: Artbook - Free DLC Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41942860/1bed3ff641ab0f1edde5b0b4328152da9c2a7ecf.png[/img]

[h1]3D Renders, Illustrations and Animations![/h1]
[list]
    [*]280+ high-quality 4k images in JPG format
    [*]18 Animations
[/list] 

[h1]NOTE: To access the Digital Artbook:[/h1]
[olist]
    [*]Right click "Sky Resort - Delphi & Jessy" in the Steam Library
    [*]Go to Properties > Local Files > Browse Local Files
    [*]Open the "Artbook" folder 
[/olist]
